segments.name: Supercritical water oxidation
segments.description: Develops and operates supercritical water oxidation systems to destroy organic and PFAS waste streams for municipal, federal, and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has determined that it operates as one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for capital sales of AirSCWO systems, service agreements, and waste destruction services where waste is received and destroyed for a fee.
revenueModel.evidence: Along with select capital sales and service contracts, WDS provides our customers with a fit-to-need waste destruction service without significant capital investment.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company launched its Waste Destruction Services business.
changes.evidence: During 2024, we announced the launch of our WDS business.
